name: cinverse-movie-recommendation
description: CinVerse - A Netflix + IMDb inspired movie recommendation website built with AngularJS 1.8.x, ES6 JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3, powered by the TMDB API.
notes: This project does NOT require running 'npm install' to work — the three AngularJS
packages above have already been downloaded from the npm registry and copied as
compiled .min.js files into js/lib/. index.html references them with plain relative
paths, so the site runs from js/lib/ with zero build step and zero CDN dependency.
This package.json exists purely to document, at a pinned version, exactly which
npm packages those local files came from.
If you ever want to re-download fresh copies yourself, you CAN run:
which will populate node_modules/angular, node_modules/angular-route and
node_modules/angular-animate with the same files already sitting in js/lib/.
